card.name: Verbs before 'on' or 'be' phrases
card.fires_on: Scattered words in general web text, often a verb or auxiliary just before a particle such as 'on', 'be' or 'in' (click on, called on, can be). Also occasionally partway through a surname.

modes.label: Verb before a particle
modes.description: A verb or the particle itself in phrasal expressions like click on, called on, bring it on.

modes.label: Auxiliary or verb in a clause
modes.description: A helper or main verb that is followed by a passive or object phrase.
modes.example: these ideas have predictable structure and<< can>> be used to help kids move forward.

modes.label: Inside a surname
modes.description: Middle of a personal name in a citation or news item.

card.writes: Promoted tokens are a mix of name pieces and odd foreign fragments, and task words are suppressed, so there is no clear effect beyond that.
card.plain: It fires on small verbs and particles in everyday web prose, such as 'click on' or 'called on', with no medical theme.
